_comment: Weights and patterns of scripts/eeat.py, the only definition of the E-E-A-T score. Every signal is measured on crawl.jsonl (served HTML), never judged by the model. Signal value v: a boolean counts 1 or 0; a count is min(n, cap) / cap; freshness takes the value of the first band whose max_days the age of dateModified does not exceed (else 'else'; no dateModified, or a date after today, gives 0). Page score (article pages only) = round(100 x sum(weight x v) / sum(weight)) over the page signals; other pages carry their signals with score null. Site signal score = the same formula over site_signals. Site score = round(site_signals_share x site signal score (already rounded) + (1 - site_signals_share) x mean of the indexable article scores (one decimal)), or the site signal score alone when the crawl holds no indexable article. A weight of 0 reports a signal without scoring it. Rounding: half up. Same crawl.jsonl, same weights and same --today give the same output. A project overrides any key with an eeat object in its config.json (--config).

author_visible.means: a byline a reader sees: an element with class or id author or byline, itemprop author, or a[rel=author], with text

author_schema.means: an author name in the JSON-LD of the article (author string, Person or Organization), or itemprop author

author_page_linked.means: the byline, a[rel=author], link[rel=author] or the JSON-LD author.url points to an internal page that answers 200 in the crawl

date_published.means: a publication date: JSON-LD datePublished, article:published_time, itemprop datePublished, a <time> element or a dated 'Published' phrase

date_modified.means: an update date: JSON-LD dateModified, article:modified_time, og:updated_time, itemprop dateModified, a <time> marked updated or a dated 'Updated' phrase

date_visible.means: a date a reader sees: a <time> element with text or a dated phrase in the visible text

freshness.means: days between the update date and --today

external_sources.means: distinct outbound links to other sites, social networks and the site's own hosts excluded

citations.means: blockquote[cite], q[cite], <cite>, footnote links (#fn, #ref, #cite, #note) and a heading named like a reference list

about_page.means: a crawled 200 page whose path has an about segment

contact_page.means: a crawled 200 page whose path has a contact segment

legal_page.means: a crawled 200 page for the legal notice, terms or imprint

privacy_page.means: a crawled 200 page for the privacy policy

organization_schema.means: a JSON-LD node of an organization type on a crawled page

organization_same_as.means: sameAs links of the best organization node

reviews_marked_up.means: Review or AggregateRating in JSON-LD (or a review property) or schema.org microdata

author_pages.means: distinct internal author pages linked from articles and answering 200

testimonial_blocks.means: elements with a testimonial class, reported only: unmarked testimonials score nothing
